pictures.author: Cosmosanchez
pictures.observations: Whole960x665 image inspected. Ruined stone podium, broad frontal stair with white lower/brick upper steps, two tall fluted front columns with worn leafy capitals, shorter stumps, roofless cella shoulders with protective tile caps, pale frontal altar and separate pale sundial column to west.

pictures.author: MAKY.OREL
pictures.observations: Whole960x720 close view inspected. Court colonnade shafts have broad longitudinal flutes, segmented stone drums and worn pale/darker stucco patches. Does not establish complete column inventory.

pictures.author: Carole Raddato
pictures.observations: Whole960x637 image inspected. Pale altar with molded base/top and rolled end ornaments. Four surviving east portico shafts carry a horizontal banded entablature with original simplified triglyph/metope-like panel rhythm, rough rear wall and little projecting upper blocks. Dark bronze replica stands between two shafts on pale pedestal. No copied statue mesh/narrative or inscription.

pictures.author: Carole Raddato
pictures.observations: Whole960x636 image inspected to fill podium side/cella gap. High rough stone podium with pale repair blocks, broken short columns, two tall Corinthian-like front shafts, white lower and brick upper stair, roofless cella wall fragments/protective tile caps and separate pale Ionic-like sundial column. No complete roof/pediment reconstruction.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific standing Apollo sanctuary at Pompeii: roofless raised podium/cella with two tall fluted front columns and varied broken stumps, frontal pale/brick stair, separate pale altar with rolled ends and sundial column; surrounding open court has surviving/broken fluted portico shafts and a short east entablature, rough enclosing walls and an original simplified volumetric bronze replica figure. No restored temple roof/pediment, broad precinct slab or copied sculpture/text atlas.
